name: Trap808
description: Trap drum machine with TR-909 ROM hi-hats and a sliding 808 bass. Hold the pad to gate — hits always lock to the incoming beat (tap timing ignored). X = hat density/rolls, Y = groove. ROOT sets the 808 key. Top-right flick arms a one-bar hat fill on the next downbeat.

params.name: HATS
params.detail: 909 hat density: 8ths → 16ths with velocity → 32nd rolls and triplets

params.name: DECAY
params.detail: 808 body length (also lengthens open hats slightly)

params.name: DRIVE
params.detail: Saturation / punch on the 808 and kick
